title: wbusmp
description: A modern cross-platform Survival SMP with Java & Bedrock support, live BlueMap, land claiming, economy, and an active community.
body:
# 🌍 WBUSMP Network

Welcome to **WBUSMP**, a community-driven Survival SMP built for players who enjoy the perfect balance between classic vanilla Minecraft and modern quality-of-life features. Whether you're building massive bases, creating automated farms, trading with other players, or exploring with friends, WBUSMP offers a long-term survival experience for everyone.

## ✨ Features

- 🌲 Semi-Vanilla Survival
- 💰 Player Economy
- 🏪 Player Shops & Trading
- 👨‍👩‍👧 Family System
- 📈 Rank Progression & Perks
- 🛏️ Sit & Lay Commands
- 🏆 Leaderboards & Scoreboards
- 🛡️ Land Claiming
- 🗺️ Live Interactive BlueMap
- 🎉 Community Events
- 📱 Java & Bedrock Cross-Play
- 💬 Active Discord Community
- ❤️ Friendly & Active Staff
- 🔄 Frequent Updates

## 🌐 Server Information

**Java Edition**
📡 IP: `play.wbusmp.xyz`

**Bedrock Edition**
📡 IP: `bedrock.wbusmp.xyz`
📍 Port: `8069`

## 🗺️ Live Map

Explore the Survival world in real time with our interactive BlueMap.

🌎 https://map.wbusmp.xyz

---

**Start your adventure today and become part of the WBUSMP community!**
